_doc: Curated registry of external RasQberry demos. Each entry pins a third-party demo repository to a full 40-character commit SHA; adding or updating an entry is a reviewed RasQberry PR and is the trust anchor for external demos. Fields per entry: id (kebab-case, must match the demo's rqb-demo.json id and its repo directory name), repo_url (must be https://), ref (full 40-char commit SHA - never a branch or tag), manifest_path (path to the manifest inside the repo, usually rqb-demo.json), added (YYYY-MM-DD), note (optional curator note). Example entry: {"id": "example-demo", "repo_url": "https://github.com/someuser/example-demo.git", "ref": "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "manifest_path": "rqb-demo.json", "added": "2026-07-12", "note": "curator note"}. Install with: rq_demo_add_external.sh <id>. Update the pin with: rq_demo_add_external.sh --update <id>.

demos.note: Quantum reinforcement-learning racing demo (docker image ghcr.io/janlahmann/traqmania, public multi-arch incl. arm64). First Fun-with-Quantum-family catalog entry.

SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk): QAOA vs classical transport assignment, tkinter GUI on the local Aer simulator - no IBM token, no network. Pinned commit carries the MIT LICENSE and the ==-pinned requirements we asked for in PR #1 (merged 2026-07-16).

SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk, MIT): browser quiz and drag-and-drop circuit composer, served from the committed production bundle via the web-static entrypoint - no Node or npm on the Pi. Pinned commit is the PR #1 merge, which brings the root build/ and package-lock.json we asked for.
